prompts.Up: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the UP sprite sheet to correct, image2 is the original Void Golem blueprint reference. Keep image1's 4-column by5-row animation-sheet layout, fantasy stone/void art identity, size, palettes and five row categories Idle/Move/Hit/Death/Skill. CRITICAL CORRECTION: make EVERY intact figure an unmistakable REAR/BACK view, facing AWAY from the viewer, never a front figure with a different chest symbol. Draw broad closed solid back shoulder plates, a heavy rear breastplate/backpack-like plate over the back, segmented stone spine, rounded back-of-helmet with its rear rim, and the backs of forearms/fists. No face, no front pointed face mask, no chest void orb, no front chest diamond/rune stack, no front breastplate V shape. Rear armor should be distinct smooth large pale stone slabs over black-violet back joints. Tiny violet seams and rear inscriptions may glow. The floating halo remains visible from behind. In Skill row arms lift FORWARD AWAY from viewer, so backs of elbows and forearms are visible, not palms thrust toward the camera. Moving row alternating feet walking away. Death row rear plates fracture and collapse away into fragments; core energy can become visible only after plates separate. Keep clean opaque stone bodies with true transparent background alpha0 in all empty gutters, no full-canvas purple fog, no panels, words, captions, grid, floor or background. Preserve all twenty separate frames and same in-cell stance/foot baseline. Do not rotate/invert a front sprite; redraw genuine rear anatomy.
prompts.Down: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent game sprite animation sheet, one enemy only, VOID GOLEM. Image 1 is the user's design blueprint reference, not an edit target. Closely reproduce the same ancient armored void construct: broad heavy humanoid, black/deep violet cracked inner stone, large pale ivory stone shoulder and forearm armor, heavy fists, engraved ancient angular runes, a circular violet-black chest void core, faceted floating violet crystals, and a broken floating stone halo. Match the reference's detailed fantasy-cartoon painterly game style, readable small sprites. Create ONLY DOWN/front facing views for a 2D tower-defense game, slight elevated orthographic camera, feet toward viewer, chest core visible. ALL 20 figures face FRONT, no rotation or alternate side angle. Strict sprite sheet layout: exactly 4 equally spaced columns by exactly 5 equally spaced rows = 20 separate full-body sprites on transparent alpha. Portrait canvas, regular empty gutters, each figure entirely within its cell, same scale and centered x, same feet baseline within every cell, halo fully contained. No ground/background/panel/grid/labels/text anywhere. Row1 IDLE four chronological frames: heavy gentle breathing, core slowly pulses, floating crystals and halo subtly change. Row2 MOVE four actual walking frames: left leg forward/right back, midstep, right leg forward/left back, recovery; arms sway, small foot dust; same front orientation. Row3 HIT four frames: initial intact stance, brief violet-white chest/armor flash and tiny chips, slight recoil, recovered stance. Row4 DEATH four frames: core destabilizes with cracks; slumping plates fracture; body collapses and stones separate; mostly scattered stone fragments and fading violet crystal dust, NOT an intact standing duplicate. Row5 SKILL four frames, defensive Void Fortification, NOT an attack: planted stationary feet, arms rising a little; both forearms lifted in stable stance as runes illuminate; intense core and bright protective rune pulse; lowering arms to ready stance. Do not translate feet or body across cells during skill. Keep body identity, materials, limb sizes, halo and palette identical across rows; avoid swords/weapons, projectile firing, generic robots, enormous floor effects. Real game-ready art with genuine transparency and clean isolated alpha.
prompts.Left: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite sheet for exactly ONE VOID GOLEM, not a boss. Image1 is primary enemy blueprint. Image2 is the selected DOWN/front animation sheet, a character identity/material/style reference only; create a NEW directional view. Match its broad ancient ivory stone armored shoulders and heavy limbs, dark purple-black inner stone, violet cracks/runes, faceted violet crystals and broken floating stone halo. Detailed fantasy-cartoon painted game art. Exactly FOUR equally spaced columns by FIVE equally spaced rows (20 chronological sprite frames total) on PORTRAIT canvas, comparable scale/proportions to image2. Genuine transparent empty gutters, alpha0 away from the subjects. No colored background/wash, no floor, no panels, no grid, no labels/text, no weapons or attack. Full bodies and floating halo contained in every cell; fixed in-cell foot baseline. Slight elevated orthographic tower-defense camera. Row1 IDLE four frames: slow heavy breath, subtle crystal/halo and violet energy pulse. Row2 MOVE four distinct actual heavy WALK poses: alternating feet, arms counter-sway, recovery, tiny foot dust; never change facing. Row3 HIT four frames: normal, short violet-white armor flash/tiny chips, brief recoil, recovered. Row4 DEATH four frames: destabilizing cracked armor, slumping body, separated collapsed fragments, mostly scattered small stones and fading violet energy; final frame must not be another intact standing Golem. Row5 SKILL four defensive casting frames: planted unmoving feet, arms lift slightly/runes light; stable raised forearms/intense energy; protective violet rune pulse; arms lower. No moving forward, no strike or projectile. Same character proportions/foot anchor across all rows. No excessive particle clouds. DIRECTION REQUIREMENT: ALL sprites face LEFT in a genuine left-facing side profile (face/chest oriented to the left edge, back on right). Heavy left-facing helmet, chest core viewed from side, overlapping armor plates, leftward foot/toe orientation, halo perspective. Both arms still cast defensively, never punch. Do not substitute a front or right-facing view.
